messages:
anya: Heads-up — our KB shortlink for the runtime guide is resolving to a 404 from the CDN. link-checker just flagged it. Can someone claim ownership and push a quick redirect or rehost? https://kb.redwood.ai/s/-/runtimes :sadface:

docs-bot: automated-scan: link-checker found 1 broken shortlink under /guides/runtime-optimizations. first-seen=1767999000 severity=medium. Suggested action: rehost asset or update shortlink target.

devon: I can take this. quick question — is the canonical content still in the monorepo at docs/runtime-guide.md or was it moved to runtime/guide-v2?

anya: thanks devon. last copy I saw was docs/runtime-guide.md (old canonical). There was a v2 split in the repo but the shortlink used the older slug. If you can rehost the current HTML snapshot that should be fine for now.

devon: ok. I'll do a minimal rehost to the CDN and add a short redirect. Plan: 1) grab canonical MD, render to html snapshot 2) upload to /cdn/docs/runtime-snapshot-176800 3) update shortlink target to that URL 4) open a PR with the redirect and a note to migrate to v2 in a follow-up.

sam: pinging eng-docs for visibility — @eng-docs please note this will add a temp snapshot asset. if someone from i18n needs the snapshot for ja/ko, please say now.

tia: i18n check — if you rehost snapshot please leave the page title and frontmatter intact so the translation pipeline can pick it up. otherwise we'll miss it in the next extraction.

devon: good call. I'll keep frontmatter. here's the sed command I'll run to fix the shortlink in the shortlinks map (local edit):

```bash
# replace old shortlink target with snapshot
sed -i 's|/s/-/runtimes|/cdn/docs/runtime-snapshot-176800.html|g' content/shortlinks.yml
```

clair: quick review note — add a short CHANGELOG line in the PR explaining why snapshot is temp and include the original canonical path for later migration. otherwise lgtm.

devon: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/p/docs/redirects/pull/412 — includes snapshot upload script + shortlink change. marked as WIP until upload completes.

docs-bot: link-checker re-scan scheduled in 10m. will post results.

anya: awesome, thanks all. @devon let us know when PR is ready for CR and I'll add to the docs CR queue. :thumbsup:
